I’m in. I will harvest 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, on our shared agreement that Kate, Jack, and Emma do the same and Luke catches zero.

Next month I’ll take no more than six tons, keeping our combined catch at 30 so the lake can recover to 100. After that, I’ll keep to ten tons under our shared 50-ton ceiling. My family taught me that this lake supports the village—not just our boats. Let’s record the agreement and make the payments together today.
